blocks.text: Sardis East Vedder: streets and boundaries

items.t: Sardis East Vedder is the part of Sardis east of Vedder Road, and the City publishes no boundary for the sub-area name — it sits inside the Schedule B5 Sardis Neighbourhood Plan area of Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500.
Vedder Road is the west edge, and BC Transit's east-side timing points sit on it at Britton Avenue and at Promontory Road.
Stevenson Road is the main east–west street, with the Wiltshire Street at Stevenson Road bus timing point beside the Sardis Park area and Sardis Secondary at 45460 Stevenson Rd.
The south edge is the Vedder River, where Vedder Park is kilometre 0 of the City's Vedder Rotary Loop Trail and the Vedder Bridge crosses back to the north bank.

blocks.text: Sardis East Vedder: the housing stock

items.t: Schools anchor the street grid on this side: Sardis Elementary at 45775 Manuel Rd, Vedder Middle School at 45560 South Sumas Rd, Stitó:s Lá:lém Totí:lt at 5337 Tyson Rd, and on Promontory, Vedder Elementary at 45850 Promontory Rd and Promontory Heights Community Elementary at 46200 Stoneview Dr.

blocks.text: Sardis East Vedder: rules that affect buyers

items.t: One accessory dwelling unit per lot is the cap under Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000.

Alluvial fan lots need a site-specific assessment by a Qualified Professional to set building setback and elevation, and an engineered concrete foundation extending at least 1.0 m above grade, under the City's Floodplain Regulation Bylaw No. 4519 guide.

blocks.text: Sardis East Vedder: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The Vedder Rotary Loop Trail starts at your south edge: the City marks kilometre 0 at Vedder Park, and the south-bank Vedder Rotary Trail South runs 5.8 km from Wilson Road back to the Vedder Bridge.
The Sardis Secondary addition added a new bus and drop-off loop and staff parking south of the school, which changes traffic patterns on the Stevenson Road frontage at school hours.

blocks.text: Sardis East Vedder: development and new projects

items.t: Sardis Secondary School expansion, 45460 Stevenson Rd: two-storey mass timber addition creating 400 new seats, capacity 1,600, estimated project value $40 million, with a new bus loop and expanded gymnasium space. Status: completed August 2026 (as of November 3, 2026).
Route 54 Promontory is this area's bus: a Cottonwood Mall loop serving Britton Avenue, Stevenson Road and the Promontory hillside timing points roughly hourly.
The Vedder Rotary Loop Trail gives a 20+ km gravel walking and cycling loop from Vedder Park, with parking at Vedder Park, Peach Park, Lickman Road and Hopedale Road.

blocks.text: Sardis East Vedder: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the lot against the alluvial fan rules first: fan lots need a site-specific Qualified Professional assessment for setback and elevation before building, under the Floodplain Regulation Bylaw No. 4519 guide.

blocks.text: What is not confirmed about Sardis East Vedder

items.t: No board- or City-published boundary for "Sardis East Vedder" was found; the east-of-Vedder-Road framing is orientation only.
Per-parcel Development Permit Area overlays, Flood Construction Levels and SD33 catchments for specific addresses were not checked; they are per-parcel and per-address checks.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Sardis East / Vedder

Centred on Sardis Park and Stevenson Road, Sardis East is the part of Sardis east of Vedder Road. Families aim for the Sardis Secondary and Sardis Elementary catchments, and it also suits military families with a Garrison Crossing connection and commuters using the Route 66 stop at Luckakuck Way.
Drive time to Sardis East Vedder

faq.a: It is a full BC Transit loop. Route 54 runs between Cottonwood Mall and Promontory roughly hourly from early morning to late evening, using timing points at Britton Avenue at Vedder Road, Wiltshire Street at Stevenson Road, Promontory Road at Vedder Road, Teskey Way and Sylvan Drive, so both the flat Sardis Park streets and the Promontory hillside are on the same loop.
faq.q: Is the Promontory bus a real service or a shuttle?

The City's small-scale housing guide states new secondary suites are not permitted below that level, and on alluvial fan lots a Qualified Professional's site-specific assessment sets the building setback and elevation first, with an engineered concrete foundation at least 1.0 m above grade. Check the lot's flood layer before pricing any suite income.

faq.a: There is no official line, because the City does not publish a boundary for the sub-area name. The physical break is the Vedder River at the Vedder Bridge, and the plan frame changes at the same time: this side is Schedule B5 Sardis, while the ground south toward the river and Garrison Crossing falls under the Schedule B6 South Vedder plan area.
